label: Mesh Gradient
description: Animated mesh gradient background with seeded color blobs. Use as z_index 0 background layer for organic, flowing backgrounds. Serves as the film's LIGHT WORLD backdrop (SPEC-world.md): pass theme:'light' for the airy editorial base, seed for a film-stable layout, and time_offset (scene film-start seconds) so the drift continues across scene cuts.

time_offset.label: Film-time offset (s) so drift continues across cuts
